intake.description: Strong winds during a storm tore off roof sheets and broke a water tank cover over the back of the house. The estimated repair cost is Rs 90,000.
intake.severity_reason: The estimated loss is between Rs 50,000 and Rs 4,99,999.

route.reason: policy number PRP-26-38841 has prefix for property; intake agent read the email as property

citations.quote: We cover the losses in this section, subject to the limits in PROP-LIM-3, the exclusions in PROP-EXC-4 and the conditions in PROP-CON-5.
Storm and flood: We pay for damage to the home and contents caused by storm, high winds or flood, subject to PROP-EXC-4.3.
Flood: We do not pay for damage caused by flood (PROP-DEF-1.4). This exclusion is amended by PROP-END-6.1.
Flood cover for the building: PROP-EXC-4.3 does not apply to damage to the home itself (PROP-DEF-1.1).

coverage.reasoning: The claimant suffered damage to the home caused by high winds during a storm, which is covered under storm and flood coverage. Although the flood exclusion applies to storm and flood coverage, it is amended by the endorsement which reinstates cover for damage to the home itself. Therefore, the storm damage to the roof sheets and water tank cover is a covered loss.

reasons: all citations verified against the clause text; outputs passed validation first time
